definitions.text_en: Fgura (a town and local council of the Port Region, Malta)
definitions.text_mt: Belt u kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun tal-Port, Malta

usage_examples.mt: Il-Fgura hija waħda mill-irħula l-aktar popolati f'Malta
usage_examples.en: Fgura is one of the most populated towns in Malta

usage_examples.mt: Jien ngħix fil-Fgura ħdejn il-Knisja Parrokjali
usage_examples.en: I live in Fgura near the Parish Church

definitions.text_mt: Xogħol jew attività mwettqa minn xi ħadd

usage_examples.mt: Il-fgħal tat-tfal fl-iskola kien ammirevoli
usage_examples.en: The children's work at school was admirable

usage_examples.mt: Kull fgħal tajjeb jistħoqqlu ħlas
usage_examples.en: Every good action deserves payment

definitions.text_mt: Li jista' jinfitehem jew jintlaħaq mill-moħħ

usage_examples.mt: Il-kliem tiegħu ma kienx fhumi għalija
usage_examples.en: His words were not intelligible to me

usage_examples.mt: It-tweġiba kienet ċara u fhumi għal kulħadd
usage_examples.en: The answer was clear and intelligible to everyone

definitions.text_mt: Forma tal-prepożizzjoni 'f'' użata qabel grupp ta' konsonanti

usage_examples.mt: Poġġiha fi ftit ilma u ħalliha ttektek
usage_examples.en: Put it in a little water and let it simmer

usage_examples.mt: Tgħix fi Triq il-Kbira
usage_examples.en: She lives in Main Street

definitions.text_mt: Kontrazzjoni irregolari u mhux ikkoordinata tal-fibri tal-muskoli, speċjalment tal-qalb

usage_examples.mt: Il-fibrillazzjoni atrijali hija kundizzjoni serja tal-qalb
usage_examples.en: Atrial fibrillation is a serious heart condition

usage_examples.mt: It-tabib iddijanjostika fibrillazzjoni wara l-elettrokardjogramma
usage_examples.en: The doctor diagnosed fibrillation after the electrocardiogram

definitions.text_mt: Metall prezzjuż abjad tleqq użat fil-ġojjellerija u l-muniti
Oġġetti magħmula minn dan il-metall, bħal pożati jew dekorazzjonijiet

usage_examples.mt: Il-fidda hija metall prezzjuż li jintuża għall-ġojjellerija
usage_examples.en: Silver is a precious metal used for jewellery

usage_examples.mt: Il-fidda tal-familja tintiret minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra
usage_examples.en: The family silver is inherited from one generation to another

definitions.text_mt: Kisi b'saff ta' fidda

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħaddied fidded il-qxur tal-metall biex jipproteġihom
usage_examples.en: The blacksmith silver-plated the metal casings to protect them

usage_examples.mt: Din il-kwadra nfidddet b'mod sabiħ ħafna
usage_examples.en: This picture frame was silver-plated very beautifully

definitions.text_mt: Ta' lewn il-fidda jew li jixbah lill-fidda

usage_examples.mt: Il-qamar kellu dija fiddija sabiħa dik il-lejla
usage_examples.en: The moon had a beautiful silvery glow that night

usage_examples.mt: Il-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu hija ta' kulur fiddi
usage_examples.en: His new car is silvery in colour

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li taħdem il-fidda jew tagħmel oġġetti tal-fidda

usage_examples.mt: Il-fiddied ħadem ġojjell sabiħ tal-fidda għat-tieġ
usage_examples.en: The silversmith made a beautiful silver jewel for the wedding

usage_examples.mt: Il-fiddieda tal-lokalità huma magħrufa għall-ħila tagħhom
usage_examples.en: The local silversmiths are known for their skill

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu lewn il-fidda jew li jfakkar fil-fidda

usage_examples.mt: Il-wiċċ tal-ilma kellu dehra fiddiena taħt id-dawl tal-qamar
usage_examples.en: The water surface had a silvery appearance under the moonlight

definitions.text_mt: Għalqa jew biċċa art ikkultivata

usage_examples.mt: Ir-raħħal ħarat il-fiddien qabel ma żeraż-żerriegħa
usage_examples.en: The farmer ploughed the field before sowing the seed

etymology_chain.definition: accusative singular of fidēs ( “ faith; belief; trust ” )

definitions.text_mt: Twemmin f'Alla jew f'xi reliġjon

definitions.text_en: verbal noun of feda: the act of redeeming, delivering
definitions.text_mt: Nom verbali ta' 'feda': l-att tal-ħelsien jew tat-tpattija

usage_examples.mt: Il-fidi tiegħu f'Alla qatt ma tħarriet
usage_examples.en: His faith in God never wavered

usage_examples.mt: Il-fidi tal-ilsiera kienet avveniment importanti fl-istorja
usage_examples.en: The redemption of the slaves was an important event in history

definitions.text_mt: Li jibqa' leali u dedikat lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa
Li hu preċiż u eżatt fir-riproduzzjoni
Imżarma u mdawwar (annimal domestiku)
Innoċenti, faċli biex jittaqqar

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelb huwa l-aktar ħabib fidil tal-bniedem
usage_examples.en: The dog is man's most faithful friend

usage_examples.mt: Din it-traduzzjoni hija fidila għat-test oriġinali
usage_examples.en: This translation is faithful to the original text

usage_examples.mt: Huwa tant fidil li jemmen kull kelma li jisimgħu
usage_examples.en: He is so naive that he believes every word he hears

definitions.text_mt: Kunfidenza jew fidi sħiħa f'xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: Għandi fiduċja kbira fil-ħila tiegħek
usage_examples.en: I have great confidence in your ability

usage_examples.mt: Il-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb hija importanti ħafna
usage_examples.en: Trust between friends is very important

etymology_chain.definition: advantage, be helpful, be of benefit

definitions.text_mt: Li juri li hu utli jew ta' benefiċċju
Li jikkontribwixxi għall-vantaġġ ta' xi ħadd

usage_examples.mt: Il-parir tiegħek fiedni ħafna fl-istudji tiegħi
usage_examples.en: Your advice proved very useful in my studies

usage_examples.mt: Din l-esperjenza żgur li tfied lill-kumpanija
usage_examples.en: This experience will certainly contribute to the company's advantage

etymology_chain.definition: to convince, to instruct, to persuade

definitions.text_mt: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jifhem xi ħaġa
Li jispjega b'mod ċar

usage_examples.mt: Il-għalliem fiehem lill-istudenti l-lezzjoni diffiċli
usage_examples.en: The teacher made the students understand the difficult lesson

usage_examples.mt: Fiehmuli l-problema pass pass
usage_examples.en: He explained the problem to me step by step

definitions.text_mt: Li jerġa' jikseb is-saħħa wara marda
Li jfejjaq minn ferita jew marda

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-operazzjoni, il-pazjent fieq kompletament
usage_examples.en: After the operation, the patient recovered completely

usage_examples.mt: Ieħtieġ żmien biex tfiq minn marda bħal din
usage_examples.en: It takes time to heal from such an illness

definitions.text_mt: Li ma jagħmel xejn jew li m'għandu x'jaqsam
Li hu mingħajr valur jew riżultat
Battal, li m'għandux kontenut
Iblah u bla sens

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġurnata kollha qagħad fieragħ mingħajr ma għamel xejn
usage_examples.en: He stayed idle all day without doing anything

usage_examples.mt: It-theddid tiegħu kien fieragħ u ma ħaddieħor ma ħadu bis-serjetà
usage_examples.en: His threats were vain and no one took them seriously

usage_examples.mt: Il-kontenitur kien fieragħ meta ftaħnieh
usage_examples.en: The container was void when we opened it

definitions.text_en: to separate people from one another
definitions.text_mt: Li jifred lin-nies minn xulxin

usage_examples.mt: Il-gwerra fierqet lill-familji għal ħafna snin
usage_examples.en: The war separated families for many years

usage_examples.mt: M'għandekx tifraq lil min iħobb
usage_examples.en: You should not separate those who love each other

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tirkeb fuq żiemel
Kavallier nobbli mgħammar b'armatura
Riekkeb, persuna mħarrġa fiż-żwiemel
Persuna mill-Persja (antik)

usage_examples.mt: Il-fieres kien jirkeb iż-żiemel tiegħu bil-ħeffa
usage_examples.en: The rider rode his horse swiftly

usage_examples.mt: Il-fierés kienu jġġieldu għall-unur u l-ġustizzja
usage_examples.en: Knights fought for honour and justice

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' kavallier jew mal-kavallierija

usage_examples.mt: L-imgieba fiersija tiegħu kienet ammirata minn kulħadd
usage_examples.en: His knightly behaviour was admired by everyone

definitions.text_mt: Għodda b'mannar li tintuża għat-tħaffir ta' blat jew art iebsa

usage_examples.mt: Uża l-fies biex ikisser il-blata l-kbira
usage_examples.en: He used the pickaxe to break the large rock

usage_examples.mt: Il-fies huwa għodda importanti għall-ħaddiema tal-barrieri
usage_examples.en: The pickaxe is an important tool for quarry workers

definitions.text_mt: Li jqarraq b'xi ħadd jew jaqbeż il-fiduċja tiegħu

usage_examples.mt: Huwa fiet lil sieħbu meta żamm il-flus għalih
usage_examples.en: He cheated his partner when he kept the money for himself

usage_examples.mt: Qatt m'għandek tfit lil min jafda fik
usage_examples.en: You should never betray those who trust you

definitions.text_mt: Ftit sħun, la sħun u lanqas kiesaħ

definitions.text_en: tepid (having a temperature close to room temperature or human body temperature)
definitions.text_mt: B'temperatura qrib dik tal-kamra jew tal-ġisem

usage_examples.mt: Il-kafè kien fietel u ma kellux togħma tajba
usage_examples.en: The coffee was lukewarm and didn't taste good

usage_examples.mt: L-ilma fietel huwa aħjar għall-ħasil mill-ilma kiesaħ
usage_examples.en: Tepid water is better for washing than cold water

definitions.text_mt: F'liema ħaġa, f'liema sitwazzjoni

usage_examples.mt: Fiex tista' tgħinni llum?
usage_examples.en: In what can you help me today?

usage_examples.mt: M'għandix idea fiex tikkonsisti l-problema
usage_examples.en: I have no idea what the problem consists of
